def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    red_cars = image_patch.find("red car")
    parking_area = image_patch.find("parking area")
    buildings = image_patch.find("buildings")

    if not red_cars or not parking_area or not buildings:
        return []

    # Find the closest building to the parking area
    closest_building = min(buildings, key=lambda b: distance(parking_area[0], b))

    # Filter red cars that are in front of the closest building
    red_cars_in_front = [car for car in red_cars if is_in_front_of(car, closest_building)]

    return red_cars_in_front
